serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Oh, it’s Shanice.
Shanice: Hello! I’m calling back. Sorry, but I couldn't pick up.
Right, I panicked and called her during the mission.
Shanice: It’s so rare for you to call, usually you just come to church. Did something happen?
I already asked someone else for help… I wouldn’t want to involve her in this too.
You: N-no, everything’s alright.
Shanice: Are you sure? 
You: Yeah. Sorry, I’m kind of busy right now…
Shanice: If you say so! Bye! 
…
I feel bad about blowing her off like that, but I have different things on my mind…
